name: Guoquan Food (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Guoquan Food (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. operates as a home meal products company in Mainland China. It offers ready-to-eat, ready-to-heat, and ready-to-cook meals; at-home hotpot and prepared ingredients; condiments and sauce products; drinks; fresh food; and western food and snacks.The company also provides barbecue products, solo-dining meals, hotpot soup base products, meatballs, shrimp paste, meat, vegetables, and pots and grills. In addition, it offers supply chain management, information technology, and enterprise management services. Further, the company processes and sells aquatic products.
